scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ek/api" "npm run dev -w @ek/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ek/web && npm run typecheck -w @ek/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ek/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ek/api && npm run typecheck -w @ek/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ek/shared && npm run test -w @ek/api && npm run test -w @ek/web
